✅ All 5 directives now DB-backed — zero external API calls during scoring.

**Audit results:**

| Directive | Before | After | Table |
|-----------|--------|-------|-------|
| earnings-momentum | ❌ Finnhub | ✅ Prisma (was already fixed) | EarningsEvent |
| news-sentiment-positive | ✅ No API | ✅ No API (unchanged) | N/A |
| social-buzz | ❌ Finnhub | ⤵️ Deferred phase-2 | SocialMention |
| insider-activity | ❌ Finnhub | ✅ Prisma.insiderTransaction.findMany() | InsiderTransaction |
| dilution-impact | ❌ Finnhub | ✅ Prisma.companyMetric.findUnique() | CompanyMetric |

**Pipeline:**
- ResearchImportService.importInsiderTransactions() → Finnhub → InsiderTransaction table → directive reads DB
- ResearchImportService.importCompanyMetrics() → Finnhub → CompanyMetric table → directive reads DB
- DB tables (InsiderTransaction, CompanyMetric, SocialMention) already in Prisma schema
- Directives return neutral with confidence=0 when DB data is missing

**Files confirmed:**
- insider-activity.directive.ts v1.1.0 — constructor takes PrismaService, queries insiderTransaction
- dilution-impact.directive.ts v1.1.0 — constructor takes PrismaService, queries companyMetric
- ResearchImportService — importInsiderTransactions() + importCompanyMetrics() cron methods exist
